text: The real cloud-search sweep at -a 5 and -a 1 ran from 19:14 on 17 September: 383 steps over two units at about 47 s a step, five hours against the 3-4 estimated. Its outputs (25 G, 332 tables) are still under sets/cloud-search/outputs. summary.tbl counts a pair as found only over the family's cutoff, as stages does: regenerated 6 Oct 2026, identical to the 22 Sep table (full 0.9049, hmmer 1,474,670 hits). parse runs takes 84 s at 24 threads, parse summary 12 s.
